name: nordlet
description: Nordlet accounting API in Claude Code: the Nordlet MCP connector plus fifteen skills for the API conventions, invoicing, supplier bills, bank reconciliation, Revolut and Stripe imports, month-end close, VAT returns, debt collection, payroll, fixed assets, onboarding and migration, recurring billing, inventory and webhooks.

api_key.title: Nordlet API key
api_key.description: A Nordlet API key (nl_...). It works in every company you are a member of, with the rights of your role in each. Owners, admins and developers create it in the Nordlet app under Account → Developers. Sent as the Bearer token on every call to https://api.nordlet.com/mcp.
